note: Questions only. Relevance judgments are deliberately absent: they are written blind, from a sheet, by `judge-sheet` and `adjudicate`. `note` on a multi-hop question says why one document is not enough, without naming a document.

questions.question: Which MQTT QoS level do the stations use when publishing readings?
How long are raw readings kept in InfluxDB before downsampling?
What mounting height did the council approve for the station on pole 14?
Why does the BME280 sit inside a radiation shield instead of the main enclosure?
How is a station's temperature offset worked out during sensor calibration?
How big is the packet a remote station sends over the radio link each minute?
What conditions make the storm warning fire?
What happens when a station's new software image fails to publish a reading after an update?
Why was a LiFePO4 battery chosen over lead-acid?
How often are the database backups taken and how long are they kept?
What did the students notice about the school field station's temperature on weekday mornings?
Who is allowed to publish on the broker and under which topics?
Which stations use the radio link, and how does that change the way their software gets updated?
questions.note: The sites on the radio link come from one document; the update restriction for them comes from another.

questions.question: Why did the breakwater station go flat in March, and what was changed afterwards?
questions.note: The cause and the fix are told in more than one document.

questions.question: How did changing the definition of a gust affect false alarms from the storm warning?
questions.note: The definition change is recorded where the software history is kept; its effect is in the alerting notes.

questions.question: Which of the harbour sites needed approval from the town, and what conditions did the committee attach?
questions.note: Which sites need approval comes from the site survey; the conditions come from the committee notes.

questions.question: If a raw reading is older than the retention period, can it still be recovered, and from where?
questions.note: Retention and backups are described in separate documents and the answer needs both.

questions.question: A station's temperature looks wrong compared with its neighbours. What should be checked and what does the calibration record contribute?
questions.note: The weekly checks and the calibration procedure are in different documents.

questions.question: List all six stations that make up the network.
Which volunteer should I ask about hardware, firmware, the database and everything else?
What are the weekly data quality checks?
Which options were considered or tried and then dropped across the hardware and the dashboards?
¿Quién quedó como responsable de la migración del corpus viejo?
¿Qué alcance tiene el borrado de un concepto?
¿Por qué se exigen citas textuales en las respuestas?
¿Qué pasa si se ingiere dos veces el mismo archivo?
¿Cuánto duró la caída del servicio y a qué se debió?
¿Por qué la alerta de disco llegó tarde?
¿Qué nivel de sensibilidad lleva cada documento y qué pasa con uno confidencial?
¿Qué condición puso Jason Sepúlveda y en qué decisión quedó registrada?
questions.note: La condición se dice en la reunión; la decisión que la registra es otro documento.

questions.question: ¿Qué relación hay entre el borrado y los registros de fusión?
questions.note: La reunión plantea el vínculo; el concepto y la decisión lo desarrollan.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se relacionan la curación explícita y la ingesta idempotente con los objetos derivados que se publican?
questions.note: Cada práctica tiene su propio documento y la respuesta necesita ambos.

questions.question: ¿El bundle o el índice es la fuente de verdad y quién lo planteó?
questions.note: Quién lo planteó está en la reunión; la regla en sí está en el concepto.

questions.question: ¿Qué decisiones se tomaron en las reuniones?
¿Quiénes participaron en la revisión quincenal de plataforma y qué rol tiene cada uno?
¿Qué puntos componen el orden del día de la revisión de plataforma?
